messages:
neal: Planning a targeted failover drill for west-2 next Thursday 23:30-00:30 UTC. Well shift traffic away from west-2 to read replicas and validate routing/fallback. Small blast radius intended.

sara: Outline: start with control-plane drains (10m), run sanity traffic checks, then simulate node failures in one pool, observe request-routing and kv-cache miss rate. End with 15m synthetic load spike to validate autoscaling and burst capacity.

oncall: Can we relax the chat p95 SLO for the hour? propose p95 -> 450ms from 200ms between 23:25-00:35. Auto-revert at 00:40.

neal: ok to relax. ops-bot will apply scheduled policy and suppression. Add alert thresholds for error-rate and tail latencies.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance created: id=failover-drill-20260603-2325, window=2026-06-03T23:25:00Z/2026-06-04T00:40:00Z, regions=[west-2], owner=@neal.

vince: Ill run the canary in west-2 control-plane first (5m). If 1) error delta <0.4% and 2) p95 <600ms proceed global. Abort on either failing.

product-bot: reminder: notify customers flagged as "high-latency-sensitive"; product wants a short banner for the status page during the window.

oncall: checklist request: include precise commands, rollback steps, and who has permission to force revert. Ill be on pager.

neal: commands (dry-run):
```
# schedule SLO relax
./infractl policy apply --name failover-slo-relax --route "chat.*" --p95-ms 450 --window 2026-06-03T23:25:00Z/2026-06-04T00:40:00Z
# start failover (manual)
./infractl drain-region --region west-2 --grace-period 600s --ticket failover-drill-20260603-2325
```
Rollback: `infractl cancel-drain --ticket failover-drill-20260603-2325` and `infractl policy revert --name failover-slo-relax`.

sara: load plan: post-failover ramp 10m to 300rps targeting chat routes to ensure prefix warmup. Script = tools/load/ramp_chat.py --target 300 --duration 600.

vince: Note: increase kv-cache prefill for critical prefixes before drain to reduce cold miss spike. Ill add prefill job 20m before start.

oncall: monitoring: watch per-region error delta, kv-cache miss rate, fallback invocations, and p95 heatmap. Ill abort if error delta >0.5% sustained 3m. Pager contact @oncall.

neal: ops-bot appended checklist to ticket. Postmortem slot scheduled next day 09:00 PT. Drop any short notes here after the drill. :rocket:
